bio.b: 8-Bit Culprit is the project of Kolkata-rooted producer and DJ Faraz Ehsan, who released his debut track 'Slugger' on Soupherb Records in 2016. In 2023 he became the first Indian producer to release on Maceo Plex's label Ellum Audio, and in 2025 he started his own label, Earth Tapes, with the EP 'Feral'.

Unnayanaa is the project of Bangalore DJ and producer Prashanth Pallemoni, whose music draws on Afrobeat, house, jazz and Brazilian rhythms. He has released on Rainy City Music, Borders Of Light, Wind Horse Records and his own label Alternate Art Forms, including tracks built from recordings made in Ethiopia and Congo. He has hosted the monthly show Syncopate on boxout.fm and debuted his Osmosis live show at Magnetic Fields in 2023.

Nida Merchant is a Mumbai-born DJ who plays disco, house, acid house and Afro-influenced music. She founded the ParaDisco party series, which has run in Delhi, Goa, London and Mumbai, and co-founded New Delhi Community Radio, where she is a resident. She has played Boiler Room and Mixmag Lab and also runs the fashion label Kefi by Nida.

VRIDIAN is an electronic music project from New Delhi led by Vir Rattan Chowdhry (Vir RC), who calls his music deep, emotive and groovy electronic music. He has released on Qilla Records and Manjumasi, moving from melodic techno and minimal house to darker techno on the 2025 EP 'Days Of Paradiso'.
GAURIWHO is a DJ whose sets move between house, deep house, breaks and UK garage. She started with a debut at Boiler Room Chandigarh and has played NH7 Weekender and Grasslands Festival.
KHXDEEJ is a DJ born in Surat who draws on Indian and Pakistani heritage. Their club sets lean on low-end, dubby textures and experimental rhythms.

Zokhuma is the Mumbai-based electronic project of Arman Menzies, formerly the guitarist of progressive metal band Goddess Gagged. He began with melodic downtempo tracks in 2014 and moved toward leftfield club music with IDM and breaks on the 2019 EP Code. He has recorded a Mixmag Asia Radio mix and played The Lab Goa back to back with Dreamstates.

Norbu is an electronic music producer, sound designer and DJ from Chandigarh, active in the underground scene since 2021. His music sits between leftfield bass, dubstep, UK garage, DnB and IDM, with releases on Deep Tempo Records, OneFortyAsia, Sec13 Records and Screech Collective.

VANI (Vani Dewan) is an open-format DJ based in California who grew up in Los Angeles and blends afrobeats, baile funk, desi fusion, bass house and hardgroove. She is also a doctoral researcher at USC's Brain and Creativity Institute, and has supported Jyoty, Zeemuffin, Flowdan, Mastane, KSHMR and DJ ADHD in the US and Asia, including an India tour.

bio.b: Dameer (Dameer Khan) is a Bangladeshi singer, producer and DJ, born in Dhaka and now based in Montreal. He started as an indie singer-songwriter, signed to the German label Majestic Casual at 17, and now DJs house and techno sets that remix 70s to 90s Bengali classics and runs Bengali raves.

src.fact: Bangladeshi singer, producer and DJ, born in Dhaka, based in Montreal; techno sets remixing Bengali classics
indie rock beginnings, house and techno, Bengali raves

bio.b: Ritzzz is a DJ who plays house, electronica and deep disco shaped by 1990s dance music, with breaks and acid in her sets. She has played Echoes of Earth in Bangalore and Circle of Love in Chennai.

src.fact: sound, breaks and acid, Echoes of Earth and Circle of Love

bio.b: Parvati is a New Delhi electronic music project. The 2022 album 'Naksha' set pitched-down Baul-style vocals, flute and classical-style singing over organic house, moving into straight house on its closing tracks 'Shikaari' and 'Nikas'.

Direct Drive is a Delhi DJ project built around vinyl and vinyl-heavy sets of house, techno, jazz, dub and global grooves. It has played in New Delhi, London, Hyderabad, Goa, Lyon, Amsterdam and Edinburgh, and was on the Magnetic Fields Nomads 2026 lineup.

Jay Drive is a New Delhi DJ who plays electro, house, minimal and techno, with over a decade behind the decks. He has been a resident and programmer at Auro and Summerhouse, opened for Helena Hauff in New Delhi in 2025, and played Magnetic Fields Nomads 2026.

Nash is a Delhi DJ and selector who plays Afro, house, disco, UK funky, garage, breaks, electro and left-field techno, and runs the Mother Dance community and events. He has played Magnetic Fields, India's Jazz Weekender, Celtronic in Ireland and a Keep Hush night in London. His first production, a remix of Nina Las Vegas and Swick's 'Shot Caller', came out on NLV Records in 2026.

Fringe Mechanics is the New Delhi selector Bhavya Singh. He was a regular at Delhi's Medium Rare (now No More Parties) gatherings and made his Magnetic Fields debut at Magnetic Fields Nomads in February 2026.

UKato is Utkarsh Singh, a New Delhi producer and DJ working in breakbeat-led bass music and drum and bass. His Aether EP came out on RAM Records' sister label Program in 2021, and he appeared on the RAM Records Annual 2022. He co-runs the nightlife agency Backdoor Parade with Kreon.

Kalbaisakhi is the Delhi producer and DJ Vibhu Singh, who started with lo-fi and hip hop instrumentals on the 2020 EP Tunnels and later moved to house, UK garage and bass along with Bollywood and Punjabi edits. He spent time in London's rave scene and co-runs New Delhi Community Radio.
Tina von Kugler is an Italian DJ, radio host and curator based in Berlin, DJing since 2023. She co-founded the collective Klub Ostkreuz and hosts on THF Radio and Halfmoon Radio.

Jaag is a DJ based in San Francisco and a native of the Bay Area. Her sets blend breaks, electro, leftfield bass, trance, acid and global percussive styles. She co-runs Maja Blast, a party series with SF DJ nofi.

Avantika is an Indian-born DJ, producer and singer who plays house music with live vocals, drawing on classical Indian vocal training and rock. Her debut EP, Moody Koyal, came out on Berlin label Get Physical Music in June 2025. Press around the release called her the first Indian DJ to play EXIT Festival in Serbia.

Full Motion Disaster, also known as FMD, is a Mumbai-based DJ and producer. He owns and runs Filth Inc., a Mumbai record label and promotional channel started in March 2019 that began with lo-fi house and moved into ghettotech, electro, breakbeat and rave. His sets mix electro, ghettotech, ghetto house, breakbeat and rave, usually rising from about 130 to 160 bpm.

KAMPAI is the solo project of Rumit Virmani, a DJ and curator from Mumbai based in Bengaluru. He plays sets across Afro house, global bass, baile funk, UK garage and drum and bass, and ran the Kampailation show on boxout.fm. He has played VH1 Supersonic and NH7 Weekender and co-founded SoMAD Fest.

GLM is a Bristol-based DJ and producer, part of Alix Perez's 1985 Music label and a resident on SWU.FM. He toured India with Drum and Bass India in April 2026, playing UK garage, 140 and drum and bass.

The Untitled One is a Bengaluru drum and bass DJ and a co-founder of Drum and Bass India, which he started in 2013, and he runs the Bangalore Massive nights. His radio show and club night Sub-Titles ran on boxout.fm, and he has shared the decks with Netsky and Goth Trad.
ADIDAMIX is a Hyderabad-based DJ whose name comes from the phrase 'I did a mix'. She plays broken beats, left-field house, baile funk, bass and dub.
Anderson1000 is a French DJ and producer who plays tribal techno and breaks in atmospheric, story-led sets.

Von Riu is a Paris-based DJ and producer from Orleans who co-founded the Jerry Horny label in 2020. He plays progressive house, trance, breaks and bass, and has released on Discoteca and Nehza Records.

Bindas is a London-based DJ and curator who plays diasporic and global club music, from Afro Desi edits and Batida to UK Funky, UK Garage, Baile and Jersey Club. She hosts the Silky Road Tour show on Brixton Radio and opened Lady Shaka's show at Phonox in London.

Big M (Mrunal Shah) is a Mumbai-based DJ and curator whose sets centre on house, with UKG, jungle, hip-hop and disco in the mix. In 2020 he started Q-Radio, an online radio platform begun during lockdown that now gives emerging DJs a place to play, and he runs it with Vansh. He has played a Monsoon Mixtapes show on Refuge Worldwide in Berlin.

Vansh is a Mumbai DJ and selector who co-founded Q Radio with Big M, a platform for long-form mixes, broadcasts and events that supports emerging artists. He played a house, minimal and deep house B2B with Big M for New Delhi Community Radio's one-year party in April 2026.

SourOG is a bass music DJ who was born and raised in Delhi and spent almost ten years in Toronto's underground scene, and her sets link the two cities. She is part of the NotABBQ crew and co-produces NOTALIVESTREAM.

FUSHI is a South Asian DJ who mixes bass music with leftfield club sounds, and has been part of the 4NC¥ collective since it started. FUSHI has played Bangalore, Goa, Kochi, Delhi, Chennai and Pondicherry, including Bangalore Massive and Dance OK Please, and has done mixes for Durian Radio, Subtle Radio, 8ball Radio and Wavlngth.

TNZ is a Bangkok-based DJ and producer who co-founded the Hypnotic TH and Vortexxx TH crews and has played in Thailand for close to ten years. Her sets run from house and tech house to melodic techno, techno and hard techno, and she plays more melodic house as TNZO.

Sublime Sound is the solo project of New Delhi producer and DJ Anhad Khanna, who mixes breakbeat, house and techno into left-field club music. He debuted in 2020 with the Final Call EP and has released on Remmah and Nervous Records. He is also one half of the Indo-American duo Anhad + Tanner.

bio.b: Mr. Disco Kid is a Japanese DJ and record dealer who plays disco, soul and rare groove from vinyl. He lives in Tokyo, where he holds a residency at DJ BAR Bridge in Shinjuku, and he has contributed mixes to NTS Radio.

Maggie Tra is a DJ and producer born in Sydney to Vietnamese and Cambodian parents and based in Hanoi. She founded Ha Noi Community Radio and the SYS Sister Sounds community and label, which runs DJ workshops for women and non-binary people.

bio.b: Blu Attic is the project of New Delhi producer and DJ Aniket Jain, who makes melodic and progressive house with Indian influences, drawing on classical and jazz piano. He has released on Anjunadeep Explorations and Indo Warehouse since 2021.

bio.b: Baalti is a DJ and production duo of Mihir Chauhan and Jaiveer Singh, both born in India, who started in the San Francisco Bay Area in 2020 and are now based in New York. Their music blends UK bass and club styles with the soundsystem traditions of West Bengal and Delhi, with releases on Krunk Kulture, All My Thoughts and Steel City Dance Discs. They host a monthly show on Rinse FM.

src.fact: duo, members, born in India, started in Bay Area 2020, now New York
UK bass with West Bengal and Delhi traditions

bio.b: EBITDA is an Indian DJ, rooted in Kolkata, who played clubs in Delhi and Bangalore before moving to the UK, where he is resident at Simple in Oxford. His sets cover electro, breaks, IDM, techno, drum and bass and acid, and he has closed for Joy Orbison.

src.fact: Simple Oxford residency, closed for Joy Orbison

bio.b: Works Of Intent is the UK techno producer Roshan Chauhan, who released as R.O.S.H. on Rekids, Turbo and Monkeytown before changing his name in 2021. His debut album Richer Sound (2023) reworks big room techno with UK breaks, and he is project manager for the South Asian collective DAYTIMERS.

src.fact: Richer Sound 2023, big room techno, UK

bio.b: Sgamo is a Milan-based DJ and curator raised in Bari, Italy, who plays global bass, rap, garage and dubstep. He runs wegoing.sound and has toured across Asia, starting in India.

src.fact: Milan-based, global bass, wegoing.sound, tour starting in India

bio.b: Peach Blok is the Bengaluru DJ and producer Rishii Rohra. His productions lean laid-back, while his club sets move through house, acid, trance and breakbeats, as heard on his 2024 Wild City mix.

src.fact: Bengaluru, Rishii Rohra, laid-back productions, house/acid/trance/breakbeat

bio.b: Su Real (Suhrid Manchanda) is a producer and DJ based in New Delhi, who moved there from New York in 2008. He became a resident DJ at Delhi club Livingroom and, with Nucleya, was among the first to bring tropical bass, moombahton and trap to India. His debut album Trapistan came out in 2014, and his recent releases are desi club edits such as the Panjabi Party Poppers series.

Odd is a DJ who mixes techno, house and progressive with dubby atmospheres, hypnotic grooves and industrial edges, shaped by years of nightlife in Asia and Europe. He has shared stages with Dubfire, VRIL, Exos and Luigi Tozzi, and played NDCR #029 in September 2025.

Tiffany Quinn is a London-based DJ, producer and radio host who plays house, disco, UK garage and global sounds. She has played Fabric, XOYO, The Jazz Cafe and Night Tales in London, and is a resident on Voices Radio with guest shows on Rinse FM, Foundation FM and Netil Radio.
